request: Copying a directory whose sub-directory cannot be opened returns an error instead of panicking, and keeps copying the rest: readable siblings still arrive at the destination with their content.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix: return error instead of panicking on an unreadable directory during copy (#6020)

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > fileutils/copy_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestCopyDirUnreadableSubdirReturnsError)$' ./fileutils >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
